steps.en: A success message is shown after the update
The message says the update followed up automatically
steps.why_en: The message only says success; it never mentions the follow-up.
steps.why_id: Pesan hanya bilang berhasil; tidak menyebut tindak lanjut.

steps.en: The notice moves to the next stage for automatic follow-up
steps.id: Notice pindah ke tahap berikut untuk tindak lanjut otomatis
steps.why_en: Edit does not change the stage; the workflow document is not in the repo.
steps.why_id: Edit tidak mengubah tahap; dokumen alur tidak ada di repo.
